visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene starts with a close-up of a bright, glowing rectangular ceiling light in a dark environment. The camera pans down to a young man with dark hair walking toward the viewer in a long, narrow pedestrian bridge. He is wearing a black, white, and grey striped jacket over a dark shirt. Massive green stylized characters in a brush-stroke font are superimposed over the whole frame. The bridge is symmetrical with metal railings and fluorescent lights receding into the background. (2) Transition to an urban city intersection at night during a heavy downpour. Numerous motorbikes and a few cars travel through the frame, their headlights creating strong reflections on the dark, wet asphalt. Streetlights and traffic signals provide the primary illumination. Neon signs from nearby shops are visible but out of focus. (3) The man is now standing inside a bright red public telephone booth located on a sidewalk. He holds the black receiver to his ear and gestures with his free hand while speaking. A bicycle is parked next to the booth. In the background, white and red lights from passing vehicles create a bokeh effect. A Wi-Fi sign is stuck to the glass of the booth. (4) Back in the pedestrian bridge, the man walks slowly, looking down and then to the side with a somber expression. His hands are in his pockets. The lighting is cool-toned, dominated by the overhead white lights. Green captions appear at the bottom center. (5) The man begins to run down the length of the pedestrian bridge. The camera tracks him, maintaining a medium full shot. His facial expression becomes more intense and determined. He occasionally looks directly into the camera. (6) He is seen on a street corner, standing beneath the overpass of the bridge. The street is busy with traffic. He gestures towards his chest and extends his arms as if reaching out. Rain is clearly visible as vertical streaks through the light. (7) A series of quick cuts shows the man on a high-level walkway overlooking the traffic below. He leans against a black metal railing. His jacket has a logo on the arm. The background is a dense urban skyline at night with numerous glowing windows and traffic lights. (8) The final sequence returns to the man in the pedestrian bridge, walking and singing with a high level of physical energy. He uses wide arm gestures and points at the camera. The video concludes with a black screen filled with a dense list of green production credits.

The BGM maintains a steady, driving tempo. (3) The chorus erupts with a powerful drum kick and layers of electric guitar. The vocals become more projected and high-pitched, demonstrating strong harmonic clarity. Background noise from city environments is extremely faint and mixed well below the signal. (4) An impact SFX triggers a shift to a lower-energy verse. The vocals are more subdued, with lower intensity. The rhythmic strength remains consistent via the bass guitar. It uses high-contrast urban imagery and a fast-paced montage to convey themes of resilience, emotional vulnerability, and the intensity of adult life within a city environment.
